stem: For A(−4) and B(8), point C divides segment AB internally in the ratio 2:1. Mark the coordinate of C on the number line.
solution: Internal division in ratio m:n with m=2, n=1: $x=\frac{n\cdot a+m\cdot b}{m+n}$.

hints.text: Cross-multiply: each end is weighted by the OTHER part of the ratio. Then divide by the sum of the ratio parts.
Only one point C is asked for. Mark just the point that divides AB internally, which lies between A and B.
Check the sign when you substitute a = −4 into the formula.

notes: Marking the coordinate on the line.
